caption: The drawing features a single wooden rocking chair centered against a plain, light beige background. The chair is constructed with vertical and horizontal wooden slats forming the backrest, which consists of three wide horizontal slats connected by two vertical side posts. The seat of the chair is flat and rectangular, made from wooden planks, and the front of the seat is slightly curved. The armrests are smoothly curved and supported by turned spindles, which match the style of the spindles forming the lower part of the seat back. The chair stands on four legs that are also turned with rounded shapes, and it has two curved rockers at the bottom that are dark brown in color. The overall color of the chair is a combination of light to medium brown wood tones with visible grain and some areas of darker shading, giving a sense of depth and texture to the wood. There are no other objects or details in the background.
title: Rocking Chair
